scope: Read-only source inspection plus exactly one public Naver GET and offline transform of captured JSON; no Render quote reload, Yahoo calls, product edits, PICK changes or price substitutions.

sourceReferences.finding: Every OPEN maps to regular / regular_live without session type or time validation.
Copies top-level localTradedAt as asOf; no query-time substitution.
Classifier receives only marketStatus and localTradedAt, not marketSessionType or overMarketPriceInfo.
Closed-market test deliberately preserves top-level regular-close price instead of overMarketPriceInfo.
Active freshness explicitly covers Korean NXT window until 20:00 KST.

reportParagraph: A single public Naver basic-quote response declares marketSessionType=afterMarket and an OPEN AFTER_MARKET leg at KRW 208,500 (19:10:45 KST), while its top-level fields remain closePrice=KRW 209,000, marketStatus=OPEN and localTradedAt=19:09:57 KST. At production main 40daf, realtime_korea.py selects the top-level price and timestamp, ignores marketSessionType/overMarketPriceInfo, and maps OPEN unconditionally to regular/regular_live. Offline transformation of this captured payload reproduces KRW 209,000 and the unsupported regular-live label. Therefore the late timestamp came from the provider field, not an application-generated lookup timestamp; the payload explicitly has after-market context, but the chosen top-level price's exact trade/session basis remains ambiguous. The payload does not explicitly identify NXT as the venue. The original 19:04 capture cannot establish an official regular-session observation; its selected 209k must not be silently replaced with the separate 208.5k after-market price. Existing tests intentionally preserve the top-level regular-close price over overMarketPriceInfo in a closed-market fixture. This is a data-contract observation only; no prices, PICK outputs or product code were changed.
limits: The historical original 19:04 provider raw payload was not captured; later raw response demonstrates the same field-mapping path and same selected 209k price.
Provider localTradedAt is copied faithfully, but its economic meaning for the chosen top-level price cannot be established from this response alone.
AFTER_MARKET is explicit; NXT venue is not explicitly named in the raw response.
No product fix is proposed or implemented.
